warfarin.take_with: Consistent time every evening. Avoid sudden changes in green leafy vegetables.

aspirin.take_with: Take with a full meal or glass of milk to protect stomach.

clopidogrel.take_with: May be taken with or without food. Do not stop without cardiologist approval.

simvastatin.take_with: Take in the evening with food. STRICTLY AVOID GRAPEFRUIT.

lisinopril.take_with: May take with or without food. Avoid potassium salt substitutes.
lisinopril.critical_monitoring: Blood pressure, serum potassium, kidney function (eGFR)

losartan.take_with: With or without food. Stay well-hydrated.

metoprolol.take_with: Take with or immediately after a meal.
metoprolol.critical_monitoring: Pulse / Heart rate (hold if < 50 bpm), blood pressure

propranolol.take_with: Take with meals. CONTRAINDICATED in asthma/COPD.

spironolactone.take_with: Take in the morning with food to avoid nighttime urination.

ciprofloxacin.take_with: Drink plenty of water. Do NOT take with milk, yogurt, or calcium within 2 hours.
ciprofloxacin.critical_monitoring: Tendon pain, QT interval, INR if on Warfarin

ibuprofen.take_with: ALWAYS take with food or milk.
ibuprofen.critical_monitoring: Kidney function, stomach pain, blood pressure

omeprazole.take_with: Take 30-60 minutes BEFORE the first meal of the day.
omeprazole.critical_monitoring: Interacts with Clopidogrel; bone density long-term

levothyroxine.take_with: First thing in the morning with a full glass of water, 60 minutes before breakfast.

prednisone.take_with: Take in the morning with a meal to reduce stomach irritation and insomnia.
prednisone.critical_monitoring: Blood sugar spikes, blood pressure, infection signs

metformin.take_with: Take with meals to minimize stomach upset and diarrhea.
metformin.critical_monitoring: Renal function (hold before IV contrast dye)

sildenafil.take_with: Never combine with nitroglycerin. Take 30-60 mins prior to activity.

nitroglycerin.take_with: Sublingual: dissolve under tongue sitting down (causes dizziness).
nitroglycerin.critical_monitoring: Blood pressure crash with PDE-5 inhibitors
